critical_fidelity_gaps.title: Per-side border weights ignored when borderStrokeWeightsIndependent is absent on NodeChange
critical_fidelity_gaps.root_cause: crates/designos-fig/src/fig.rs:450 only reads border*Weight if nc.get("borderStrokeWeightsIndependent") == Some(true). In real .fig v106 files, Figma writes borderBottomWeight/borderTopWeight/etc. without setting borderStrokeWeightsIndependent=true on 35,500+ nodes (table cells, dividers, headers). Note that convert_override (fig.rs:865) already checks if any border*Weight field is present.
critical_fidelity_gaps.fix: In convert_node (fig.rs:450), use the same predicate as convert_override: check borderStrokeWeightsIndependent == true OR any of borderTopWeight, borderRightWeight, borderBottomWeight, borderLeftWeight is present.

critical_fidelity_gaps.title: Per-corner radii ignored when rectangleCornerRadiiIndependent is absent on NodeChange
critical_fidelity_gaps.root_cause: crates/designos-fig/src/fig.rs:464 requires rectangleCornerRadiiIndependent == true on convert_node, whereas convert_override (fig.rs:878) checks if any of the 4 rectangle*CornerRadius fields exist.
critical_fidelity_gaps.fix: In convert_node (fig.rs:464), read individual corner radii whenever rectangleCornerRadiiIndependent == true OR any of the 4 rectangle*CornerRadius fields is present.

critical_fidelity_gaps.title: Unmapped VariableField bindings in variableConsumptionMap / parameterConsumptionMap
critical_fidelity_gaps.root_cause: crates/designos-fig/src/fig.rs:624 bound_variables() drops VISIBLE, TEXT_DATA, OVERRIDDEN_SYMBOL_ID, and BORDER_*_WEIGHT, as well as Effect variable fields and gradient stop variable bindings.
critical_fidelity_gaps.fix: Add VISIBLE -> 'visible', TEXT_DATA -> 'characters', OVERRIDDEN_SYMBOL_ID -> 'mainComponent', BORDER_TOP_WEIGHT -> 'strokeTopWeight', BORDER_RIGHT_WEIGHT -> 'strokeRightWeight', BORDER_BOTTOM_WEIGHT -> 'strokeBottomWeight', BORDER_LEFT_WEIGHT -> 'strokeLeftWeight', plus Effect.{radiusVar,spreadVar,xVar,yVar} and Paint.stopsVar in fig.rs and fig_export.rs.

critical_fidelity_gaps.title: CSS Grid (stackMode == GRID) v106 anchor and track sizing fields unmapped
critical_fidelity_gaps.root_cause: crates/designos-fig/src/fig.rs:607 checks gridColumnAnchorIndex / gridRowAnchorIndex, but v106 also emits gridColumnAnchor / gridRowAnchor (172 nodes in VSF - PCP.fig) and CSS-style track sizing strings in gridColumnsSizing / gridRowsSizing plus gridColumnGap / gridRowGap.
critical_fidelity_gaps.fix: Support gridColumnAnchor / gridRowAnchor as fallback for gridColumnAnchorIndex / gridRowAnchorIndex, parse gridColumnsSizing / gridRowsSizing track definitions, and map gridColumnGap / gridRowGap to item_spacing / counter_spacing for GRID frames.

critical_fidelity_gaps.title: Primary-axis auto-layout sizing bug in SymbolOverride when stackMode is inherited
critical_fidelity_gaps.root_cause: In convert_override (fig.rs:940), when an override sets stackPrimarySizing without overriding stackMode on the same node, it calls stack_sizing() which maps RESIZE_TO_FIT -> AUTO, but on the primary axis Figma uses RESIZE_TO_FIT_WITH_IMPLICIT_SIZE for FIXED and RESIZE_TO_FIT for AUTO (or vice-versa depending on version; see fig.rs:1043).
critical_fidelity_gaps.fix: Unify primary vs counter sizing decoding between convert_auto_layout and convert_override.

critical_fidelity_gaps.title: derivedTextData and derivedSymbolData size/transform overrides for instances
critical_fidelity_gaps.root_cause: fig.rs reads fillGeometry and strokeGeometry from derivedSymbolData (lines 1269-1305) to patch vector paths inside instances, but ignores size, transform, and derivedTextData from derivedSymbolData. When an instance is resized or its text overrides wrap differently, child transforms/sizes computed by Figma live in derivedSymbolData.
critical_fidelity_gaps.fix: Apply derivedSymbolData size and transform (and optional derivedTextData line/baseline metrics) during instance expansion before running local auto-layout fallback.

critical_fidelity_gaps.title: FigJam / Board Connector, ShapeWithText, Brush, and Page Divider fields in v106
fields: CONNECTOR (190): connectorStart, connectorEnd, connectorLineStyle, connectorType, connectorTextMidpoint, connectorControlPoints
critical_fidelity_gaps.root_cause: fig.rs maps CONNECTOR, SHAPE_WITH_TEXT, and BRUSH only when written with custom designos-fig fields, or falls back to Unknown/Vector for native Figma v106 CONNECTOR / SHAPE_WITH_TEXT / BRUSH fields, and ignores CANVAS.isPageDivider.
critical_fidelity_gaps.fix: Map native v106 connectorStart/connectorEnd (ConnectorEndpoint), connectorLineStyle, connectorType, shapeWithTextType, and CANVAS.isPageDivider.
